facts.fact: The Education Sector Plan 2023-2027, the ministry's costed plan, says the 'traditional EMIS' of routine administrative tasks and student head counts will be expanded into a real-time, integrated EMIS ecosystem with data down to class and student level, decentralised digital data entry, a digital profile of each student and a link to the national ID, and gives 'strengthen EMIS' a programme and an expenditure line in each subsector including primary; no date is given for the statement, so the document's published date is used.

The Education Sector Plan 2023-2027 lists EMIS as a department of the Ministry of Education and Technical Education and makes the ministry responsible for building the planned integrated EMIS ecosystem; no date is given, so the document's published date is used.
